candidates.title: From bench to Brussels and back: co-producing personalized medicine in the European Union
candidates.summary: From bench to Brussels and back: co-producing personalized medicine in the European Union. Personalized medicine (PM) has emerged as both a major scientific endeavor and a strategic policy priority in the European Union (EU). Drawing on discourse theory and the science and technology studies concept of co-production, we use PM as a case of a co-produced scientific and policy project to examine not only how scientific advances shape policy agendas but also how EU political priorities, funding programs, and governance frameworks shape the scientific field.
